description: Raise requested reasoning effort for the five series that were still at medium: GPT-5.6 Luna to xhigh, and Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B A55B, Gemini 3.7 Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Muse Spark 1.3 to high. Applied by the first collection that observes a new war id, recorded in data/war_settings.json, and carried forward to later wars until a new preset supersedes it. GLM 5.3 Flash (already max) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (already high, thinking enabled) are unchanged.
